metadata.disclaimer: Contains all 3,872 Class 2 residential properties (1–4 family homes, townhouses, and condominiums) in Borough of Glen Rock directly from the official State of New Jersey MOD-IV assessment roll (District 0222). All figures (Block, Lot, Qualifier, PAMS PIN, Assessed Land, Assessed Improvement, Total Net Assessment, Prior Certified Tax Billed, Year Built, Lot Size, Building Description, and Deed Sale Records) reflect official municipal tax records without synthetic interpolation.
